articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
articles.snippet: Loans use third-party custodians for bitcoin holdings and rely on court-ordered sales if borrowers default.

articles.title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
articles.snippet: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support “pro-crypto” candidates in 2026.

articles.title: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds ’18 trillion XRP’ bug: Hodler’s Digest
articles.snippet: A user reports buying a tampered Ledger from a big retailer in Europe. Security researchers use AI to uncover a “$94 billion” XRP bug — but receive just a $250K bounty.

articles.title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
articles.snippet: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.
